# SanketDesk

> High-performance, pure Windows Forms desktop notification library, toast engine, and interactive studio for .NET 8.0 Windows and .NET Framework 4.6.1.

## Key Information
- Pure Windows Forms (GDI+), zero external runtime DLL dependencies.
- Multi-targets `net8.0-windows` and `net461`.
- Single coordinated clock (0% CPU when idle); zero per-toast timers.
- Bounded admission controller with lock-free counters for 10k+ burst handling.
- Deterministic coalescing (`CoalesceByKey`, `CoalesceByTitle`).
- Interactive PropertyGrid configurator studio in `samples/ConfiguratorSample`.

## Quick Start
```csharp
using Notifier;

// 1. Initialize once
Notifier.Initialize(new NotificationConfig
{
    HostForm = this,
    Position = NotificationPosition.BottomRight,
    BurstStrategy = BurstStrategy.CoalesceByKey
});

// 2. Show toasts safely from any thread
Notifier.ShowSuccess("Connected", "Feed active.");
Notifier.ShowError("Rejected", "Order breached risk limit.");
```
